findings.claim: FACT. The new message 'reranker model not found in cache - run:  docdistance init wmd-wrt-source --backend torch' and its comment 'init fetches the openvino weights unless --backend names the other set' hold only for the HuggingFace source. With `--source` (local folder or S3 prefix) init ignores `--backend` whenever the mirror holds the folder reranker-openvino-int8: it copies the OpenVINO files and never fetches BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, so a user on the torch backend who follows the message with their usual `--source` gets the same error again. MATERIALITY: a user on `--backend torch` or `--gpu` who provisions from a mirror only; not the primary path (OpenVINO on CPU, HuggingFace source), no wrong number, no regression against 2ff35bf - src/docdistance/bootstrap.py is unchanged since release 1.1.32. material=false, out of bar. REMEDY: DEFER and put to the user together with the round-1 declined item on the encoder and NLI hints (same cause: the backend is not part of the mirror path). The smallest edit, if one is wanted, is to reword the comment at pipeline.py:1079 to 'from HuggingFace, init fetches ...'; making `_mirror_one` backend-aware would be a NEW MECHANISM and is not proportionate to this finding.
